notes: Printed below the table: 'T-BOD: Total BOD, s-BOD: Soluble BOD, TSS: Total suspended solids, T-N: Total nitrogen, T-P: Total phosphorus, Al: Aluminium, T-coliform: Total coliform, ND: Non- detected, E: Exponent' and 'Source: JSWA, 2003'.
Printed number is '5-47' (hyphen) in the caption while neighbouring tables use a full stop; the printed form is kept as the number.

Transcriber layout note: the printed table has two left columns (a process label and an (A)/(R) label) plus its own top-left empty cell. Only one top-left empty cell is printed; it is kept as the first empty header cell.
(A) and (R) are not expanded anywhere in the printed table; they are transcribed as printed. (A) rows hold single values and (R) rows hold ranges.
The legend prints 's-BOD' (lower case s) while the column header prints 'S-BOD' (upper case). Both are retained as printed.
Printed as 'TColiform' (no hyphen) in the header while the legend reads 'T-coliform'; retained.
Printed as 'ND-11.00' and '9.6E+04 - 7.3E+05'; the 'E+NN' exponent form and the spacing around the dash are retained.
Printed as 'Removal (%)' with the (A) cell only; no removal range row is printed.
The legend line 'T-BOD: ... ND: Non- detected, E: Exponent' is the printed key for this table and is recorded in notes only, not as table rows.
